purpose: No element of TerminologyCapabilities states which implicit value sets a server resolves.

element.short: An implicit value set form this version resolves
element.definition: One implicit value set form this code system version resolves, repeated once per form. A version that resolves none carries no such extension.
The value set URL template, spelled as the code system's page spells it, with each placeholder in square brackets, for example http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs=isa/[sctid].

What the placeholders take: none when the pattern is the URL as it stands, code when the one placeholder takes a code of the system, expression when the placeholders take free text such as an ECL expression or a UCUM unit.
